Definition: to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bind, besiege, confine, cramp; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to confine, secure; 1a2) to shut in, beseige; 1a3) to shut up, enclose; 2) (Qal) to show hostility to, be an adversary, treat as foe; 3) (Qal) to form, fashion, delineate
